title: Picture the Epsilon: Pursuing Identity-Level Privacy Guarantees for Images
abstract: arXiv:2608.17147v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image-to-image face generators are widely used, and visual dissimilarity between their outputs and source images is sometimes treated as evidence of privacy. Auditing whether these systems satisfy formal identity-level (epsilon, delta)-differential privacy requires choosing among several distinct routes for converting embedding-space observations into estimates or bounds on the differential privacy parameter epsilon. We present a comparative study of four such audits applicable to pre-trained, black-box face generators: a Gaussian-mechanism reading of per-identity sensitivity (GaussMech); a per-dimension kernel-density log-ratio aggregated by basic composition (KDE-LR); an analytical population-level lower bound on pure-DP epsilon derived from the maximum mean discrepancy via the total variation distance (MMD-TV); and a hypothesis-testing evaluation of a cross-validated classifier's out-of-fold ROC (ROC-HT). translated_title: 描绘ε：追求图像的身份级隐私保证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17147v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：图像到图像的人脸生成器被广泛使用，其输出与源图像之间的视觉不相似性有时被视为隐私的证据。审计这些系统是否满足正式的身份级(ε, δ)-差分隐私，需要在多种将嵌入空间观测转换为差分隐私参数ε的估计或界限的路线中进行选择。我们提出了四种适用于预训练、黑盒人脸生成器的审计方法的比较研究：基于每身份敏感性的高斯机制解读（GaussMech）；通过基本组合聚合的逐维核密度对数比率（KDE-LR）；通过总变差距离从最大均值差异推导的纯DP ε的解析群体级下界（MMD-TV）；以及交叉验证分类器折外ROC的假设检验评估（ROC-HT）。对每种方法，我们进行了详细的实验……
tldr: 本文系统比较了四种审计黑盒人脸生成器身份级差分隐私的方法，并揭示了各方法的适用性与局限性，为隐私保证验证提供了实践指南。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares four audit methods for identity-level differential privacy in black-box face generators, revealing their applicability and limitations to guide practical privacy verification.
